headline: Base Fighting Spreads Along the Front
war_summary: Since the last edition, the ownership ledger has grown livelier on several fronts, though no single sector has broken clear of the field. FishermansRowHex now records forty-one strategic-base events in twenty-four hours, six in the latest six-hour window and none in the newest two; all nine bases presently stand Colonial. WeatheredExpanseHex remains a principal furnace with thirty-seven daily events and seven in six hours, its holdings divided five Colonial to four Warden. StlicanShelfHex has thirty events, five in six hours, and a close five-Warden, four-Colonial split. LinnMercyHex shows renewed pressure, with three events in two hours and eight in six, while its ledger reads ten Colonial bases to one Warden. MooringCountyHex has thirteen daily events and three in six hours, but its fighting has cooled sharply in the newest two-hour span; all twelve bases remain Warden. GodcroftsHex adds nine daily events, though none in the latest six hours. Heavy casualty and enlistment surges in CallahansPassageHex, StonecradleHex, and other sectors mark substantial activity, but their recent packets show fewer or no ownership changes.
